findings.description: Hardcoded Color(0xFF1B2E22) used as viewfinder background. Does not adapt in dark mode. Replace with a ColorScheme token such as colorScheme.surfaceContainerLow or colorScheme.inverseSurface.
Colors.white54 used for the 'Point at your ingredients' label. Not ColorScheme-derived; will be invisible on light surfaces. Replace with colorScheme.onSurface.withValues(alpha: 0.54) or equivalent.

BorderRadius.circular(8) is hardcoded rather than read from SnapFoodShapes.chip. Currently matches the spec value but will silently diverge if the shape token changes. Use Theme.of(context).extension<SnapFoodShapes>()?.chip ?? 8.0.
Inline border and enabledBorder specify BorderRadius.circular(12) instead of inheriting from InputDecorationTheme. Stays in sync only by coincidence with SnapFoodShapes.input.
